name: Frasers Property Thailand Industrial Freehold & Leasehold REIT
summary: The Frasers Property Thailand Industrial Freehold & Leasehold REIT operates as a dedicated real estate investment trust. Its primary function involves the acquisition, management, and subsequent leasing or rental of various industrial properties, specifically encompassing factories and warehouse facilities. This entity was established on December 12, 2014, and maintains its principal place of business in Bangkok, Thailand.
